allow_when_any: a competitor exposes a concrete gap inside Hardware-Splicer's native physical-agent or hardware-evidence lane
a live external route becomes materially more winnable from a bounded change
a real evaluator, user, provider or physical artifact exposes a concrete defect
a change improves artifact-first usability without altering frozen evidence semantics
reject_when_all: the change only imitates a generic competitor feature
the capability is better consumed through an adapter or source tool
no live route, user, evaluator or evidence gap benefits
the change expands generic AI-agent surface area without strengthening Hardware-Splicer's native differentiation

native_hs_lane: hardware engineering evidence and revision-bound validation

person_level_rule.description: For jobs, RAs, fellowships, residencies and PhDs, HS remains a flagship work sample whenever physical AI, robotics, electronics, EDA, embodied systems or consequential agent control is material. Reallocation of a project-level route does not weaken HS in the person's evidence bundle.
